content: Hessa gishshas Yisaaqi Yaaqoobe xeygidi, «Kanaane asaa macca naytappe nees machcho ekkofa.
Dendada ne aayey aawa Baatu7eelekko, Mesphexoomiya biitta baada heeppe ne aayey isha Laaba macca naytappe issiniyo nees machcho ekka.
Ubbaa Dandayza Xoossi nena anjjo; izi nees daro nayta immo; nena daro deres aawa histto.
Abrahaame anjjida mala nenanne ne zereth Xoossi anjjo; hayssa Abrahaamey immida biittanne nekka imaththateththan de7ida biittaa nees immo» azazides.
Histtiin Yisaaqi Yaaqoobe yeddiin Yaaqoobey Mesphexoomiya biitta Laabakko bides. Laabay Yaaqoobenne Eesawe yelida Irbiqas ishanne Aaraame biitta as Baatu7eele naa.
Eesawey Ekkida Hara Machcheyo
Yisaaqi Yaaqoobe anjjidayssa heeppe machcho ekkanaas Mesphexoomiya biitta iza yeddidayssa qasseka izi Yaaqoobe anjjida wode, «Kanaane maccas ekkofa» gi azazidayssa siyides;
Yaaqoobeykka ba aawassinne ba aayeys azazettidi Mesphexoomiya biitta bidayssa Eesawey erides.
Eesawey iza aawa Yisaaqay Kanaane macca nayta ay mala ixxizaakkonne hessan erides.
Hessa gishshas Eesawey Abrahaame naa Isma7eelekko biidi iza nayo Mahilaato ba machchey bolla gujji ekkides. Izakka Nebayoote michcho.
Yaaqoobe Agumo
Yaaqoobey Bersaabeheppe Kaaraane baanaas dendides.
Izi issi soo gakkishin arshey wulliin heen aqides; he soon diza shuchchatappe issi shuch ekki borkotidi heen dhiskides.
Agumozan biittan eqqidi xeeray pude salo gakkiza yangare be7ides; yangareza bolla Xoossa kiitanchchati duge wodhdhishininne pude kezishin be7ides.
Yangarezas bolla xeeran GODAY eqqidi iza, «Tani GODAA ne aawa Abrahaame Xoossa, Yisaaqa Xoossa. Ha ne ichchida biittaa ta neessinne ne zereththas immana.
Ne zereththay biitta ace mala darana; isttika oyddu bagga gakkana; biitta bollan diza asi wuri ne baggaranne ne zereththa baggara anjjettana.
Tani nenara days; neni bizaso ubbaan tani nena naagana; qasse tani nena ha biitta guye zaarada ehana; tani nees ooththana gidayssa ooththana; nenakka yeggike» gides.
Yaaqoobey dhiskofe beeggidi, «Tani erabeekkefe attiin GODAY tumu hayssan dees» gides.
Izi babbidi, «Hayssi ay mala babisizasoo! Hayssi Xoossa Keeththafe attiin haraso deenna; hayssi salo penge» gides.
Yaaqoobey wonteththa gallas maalado wonttara dendidi ba borkotida shuchchaa ekkidi tuussa mala essidi Xoossas dummasanaas iza bolla zayte gussides.
Yaaqoobey he sohoza Beetele
gi sunththides; he katamaya hessafe kase Looza geetettawus.
Yaaqoobey, «Ne tanara gidada ta biza ogen ne tana naagikko taas miza qumanne may7o ne immiko ta aawa soo saron ne tana zaarikko neni GODAY ta Xoossa gidana.
Tani tuussa mala essida ha shuchchay Xoossa keeth gidana; neni taas immiza ubbaafe tammaafe issi kushe tani nees immana» gi adinettides.

footnotes.text: Beetele: Beetele guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Xoossa keeth» guussa.
